meta.what: Ground truth for the 12 seeded defects. The reviewer never reads this file.

types.A: approval gap: a write on an identity or finance system with no approval step before it
types.B: permission gap: a write whose scope is admin-level or broader than the request needs

visibility.visible_in_draft: the defect can be read off the draft
visibility.needs_connected_system: the draft looks fine; spotting the defect needs a look inside the connected system

meta.seeded_by: hand, by the project author, in scripts/seed.mjs
